themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing specific software, platforms, or techniques that leverage AI to facilitate or enhance the research process, including data gathering, analysis, and synthesis.

themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Content focused on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with systems to achieve research objectives.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles detailing AI tools and applications that aid developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Covers AI applications used for creating written content, such as articles, marketing copy, or creative writing.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles focused on AI tools and techniques that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Content that explores how AI is being integrated into the design process, from ideation and prototyping to UI/UX refinement and generative design.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and discussions on how AI is affecting job roles, skill requirements, and employment trends across various industries.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles investigating the use, impact, and user perception of AI-powered chatbots, including their accuracy, biases, and limitations.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Content that compares, benchmarks, or critically assesses the performance and usability of various AI tools.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Focuses on studies and analyses concerning AI's role in hiring processes, including its impact on candidate selection, bias, and job market shifts.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
